name: The 27th Songkhla Marathon 2026
short_description: The 27th Songkhla Marathon 2026 is a full and half marathon event held on August 23, 2026, at Tinsulanonda Stadium in Songkhla, Thailand.
ai_summary: The 27th Songkhla Marathon 2026 is a full marathon event scheduled for August 23, 2026, in Songkhla, Thailand, starting and finishing at Tinsulanonda Stadium. Sunday's programme has the full marathon (42.195 km, 3am start), the half marathon (21.1 km, 4am) and a 10 km mini marathon (4.45am), with a 5 km fun run on the evening of Saturday 22 August.

core_facts.venue: Black Chair Patio, Chalatat Road, Tinsulanonda Stadium, Songkhla

pros: Flat course: the 2026 profile stays between about sea level and 15 m
Roads fully closed to traffic on race morning
Water about every 2 km, then almost every kilometre from 34 km
Low entry fees: 1,200 to 1,400 baht for the marathon in 2026
World Athletics road race label and AIMS membership
cons: Saturated air before dawn: 25-26°C with a dew point of 25°C in 2026
Cut-offs appear to be applied on gun time, with six marathon checkpoints
Tight 1 hour 40 limit for the 10 km
3am marathon start means a very early night
research_highlights: The 2026 marathon starts and finishes at the Black Chair Patio on Chalatat Road, loops through Songkhla old town, then runs out and back along Songkhla Lake to a turn at 21 km; the official elevation profile stays within about 15 m.
The race gained World Athletics Road Race Label certification in 2023, marking it as an internationally recognised course.
Distances offered are a 5 km fun run on Saturday evening, and a 10 km mini marathon, half marathon and full marathon on Sunday, with the marathon starting at 3:00am.
At Hat Yai airport, about 37 km inland, it was 25-26Â°C with mist and 94-100% humidity through the early hours of the 2026 marathon, rising to 30Â°C by 9am and 32Â°C by the 10am finish close.
research_watchouts: The marathon has a 7-hour limit with checkpoint cut-offs from 5 km (3:50am) to 40 km (9:40am); runners who miss one are disqualified, transported back to the finish and do not receive a finisher medal or shirt.
Entry fees are not refunded under any circumstances, entries cannot be transferred, and race bibs must be collected in person, with passports required for foreign runners.
No runner accounts of the 2026 race were found; the first-hand reviews available online describe editions from the 2000s.

faqs.question: When is the 27th Songkhla Marathon 2026 taking place?
faqs.answer: The 27th Songkhla Marathon 2026 took place on Sunday 23 August 2026, with the marathon starting at 3am, the half marathon at 4am and the 10 km at 4.45am. The 5 km fun run was held the evening before, on Saturday 22 August, starting at 6.10pm, all from Tinsulanonda Stadium in Songkhla.

faqs.question: What distances are offered at this race?
faqs.answer: The 27th Songkhla Marathon 2026 offers four distances: a full marathon of 42.195 km, a half marathon of 21.1 km, a 10 km mini marathon and a 5 km fun run. The first three are run on Sunday morning, while the fun run takes place on Saturday evening, the day before.

faqs.question: Where is the race venue located?
faqs.answer: The race starts and finishes at the Black Chair Patio on Chalatat Road, within the Tinsulanonda Stadium grounds in Songkhla, Thailand. Race packs are collected in the stadium gymnasium on the Friday and Saturday before race day, and bibs must be collected in person, with passports shown by foreign runners.
